stem.text: A hill stands between a radio transmitter and a house, as shown.

stem.alt: Hill between a house on the left and a radio transmitter on the right, with labels house, hill and radio transmitter.

stem.text: The radio transmitter cannot be seen from the house, but radio waves from the transmitter are received at the house.

A.text: The wavelength of light is longer than the wavelength of radio waves so there is more diffraction of light over the hill.

B.text: The wavelength of light is shorter than the wavelength of radio waves so there is more diffraction of light over the hill.

C.text: The wavelength of radio waves is longer than the wavelength of light so there is more diffraction of radio waves over the hill.

D.text: The wavelength of radio waves is shorter than the wavelength of light so there is more diffraction of radio waves over the hill.
